classification_rules.UNIFORM_SYSTEMATIC_CANDIDATE: directional coherence >=0.80 and sector RMS ratio <1.75
classification_rules.LOCALIZED_DISAGREEMENT_CANDIDATE: sector RMS ratio >=2.0 or max residual >=2.5*median

hard_rules: classification labels are diagnostic candidates, not causal conclusions
no threshold changes after archaeological residuals are observed
failed archaeological fits are analyzed and preserved
residual patterns cannot establish ritual meaning
